1.Nf3 Nf6 2.g3 d5 3.Bg2 e6 4.O-O.strategy: Castles before committing the centre. White's set-up is complete and the choice of central plan stays open, which is the strength of the system: Black has to guess which pawn break is coming.

1.Nf3 Nf6 2.g3 d5 3.Bg2 e6 4.O-O Be7.strategy: Brings the king's bishop out and prepares to castle, keeping the position compact and safe. Black is solid but still waiting: White has finished development and can pick the plan that suits it.
